params.name: count
params.description: The number of results to return. This value must be a number between `1` and `100` (default).

params.name: startPosition
params.description: The starting zero-based index position of the results set from which to begin returning values. The default value is `0`.

params.name: managedOnly
params.description: When **true,** only the regions that the current user manages are returned. The default value is **false.**
